title: Poincare Homology Sphere Gauge Cosmology and Semiclassical Gravity (S^3/I*): Open Reproducibility Archive, Verification Suite, Claim Ledger, and Technical Reports (Tracks I-V)
description: Self-contained Python, NumPy/SciPy, and 50-digit mpmath verification suite, exact spectral and differential-geometry oracles, deterministic JSON reference datasets, automated smoke tests, Claim Ledger (including permanently preserved retracted dead ends), and six standalone technical reports (Tracks I-V) exploring classical Bianchi IX general relativity, SU(2)_L Yang-Mills-Higgs sphalerons and dynamical Hosotani restoration, pure-graviton 1-loop spectral geometry, nonlocal Weyl-squared dispersion, and half-antipodal Talbot revivals on the Poincare homology sphere S^3/I* and spherical space forms S^3/Gamma. Produced through a human-directed, AI-assisted symbolic and numerical verification workflow.
